english.title: Fly UK aircraft in Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum airspace when not appropriately equipped / authorised
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command ]_

of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..) which flew in Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum airspace when it was not equipped with height keeping systems approved, installed, maintained and, while flying in that airspace, operated in accordance with, article 82(a) of the Air Traffic Order 2016 and which enabled the aircraft to maintain the required height keeping performance capability, or was otherwise authorised by the appropriate air traffic control unit
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 82 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
